name: Barbell Good Morning
steps: Rest a barbell securely across your upper back, stand with feet shoulder-width apart, and unlock your knees slightly.
Brace your abdomen and secure the bar against your upper back with an even grip.
Hinge smoothly back at your hips to incline your torso forward until you feel a clear hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips powerfully forward and squeeze your glutes to return upright.
tips: Keep the bar balanced straight over your midfoot throughout the hinge.
Stop folding forward before your lower back begins to round.
